categories.main_business_segments: Yinchuan Weili Transmission Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialized wind power gearboxes, including yaw gearboxes, pitch gearboxes, and speed increasers. The company focuses on providing precision transmission solutions for the renewable energy sector, particularly wind power. It also develops products for engineering machinery, new energy vehicles, and other industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced multi-stage planetary transmission technology for its wind power gearboxes and speed increasers. It employs five-axis CNC machining centers, advanced heat treatment processes like carburizing, quenching, and nitriding, and precision gear grinding to achieve high gear accuracy and durability. The manufacturing process emphasizes strict quality control, including ultrasonic and magnetic particle inspections, and integrates intelligent factory management systems such as PLM, ERP, MES, and DNC for efficient production and quality assurance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic wind turbine manufacturers such as Goldwind, Dongfang Electric Wind Power, Envision Energy, Hunan Xinglan, Yunda Co., Mingyang Smart Energy, CRRC Wind Power, and Sany Heavy Energy. The company also serves international clients like Siemens Gamesa, Nordex, EUnion, and Adani New Industries. The primary market is the wind power industry, with expanding efforts in overseas markets and emerging sectors like engineering machinery and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Yinchuan, Ningxia. It has established overseas service centers and sales networks in Germany (Hamburg), India (Chennai), and Japan (Tokyo) to support international customers and expand global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yinchuan Weili Transmission Technology operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segments of the wind power supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and supply of core transmission components such as gearboxes and speed increasers to wind turbine manufacturers (downstream). It also manages procurement of raw materials and components, some of which are outsourced for processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-power, high-efficiency wind power transmission components, including integrated speed increasers for large-scale wind turbines (6.25 MW and 8 MW models). It invests heavily in R&D for product lightweighting, cost reduction, noise suppression, and durability improvements. Additionally, it is developing new products for new energy vehicles and engineering machinery, and advancing digital transformation through smart factory construction and enhanced information systems integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized wind power gearboxes and speed increasers to wind turbine manufacturers. Sales are secured via bidding and commercial negotiations, with pricing based on contract terms. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial asset investments, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in the wind power gearbox market, competing with major players such as Goldwind, Envision Energy, Mingyang Smart Energy, and international firms like Siemens Gamesa and Nordex. It holds a strong market position in China and is expanding its footprint internationally. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer relationships to maintain competitiveness amid increasing market pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 345 million, a 37.6% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss of about RMB 29.5 million due to intensified market competition and increased costs. Total assets grew to over RMB 2.1 billion, reflecting significant investment in smart factory construction. The company has expanded its workforce and R&D spending, signaling a focus on long-term growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yinchuan Weili Transmission Technology offers high-precision, durable, and efficient wind power transmission solutions tailored to diverse wind conditions. Its products feature advanced multi-stage planetary gear designs, high torque density, long service life (up to 20 years), and low noise operation. The company’s smart factory and integrated digital management systems enhance product quality and delivery reliability. Strong customer relationships and continuous innovation underpin its competitive advantage in the renewable energy equipment sector.
